subject: Sponsor demo rotation, badging allocation and on-stage timing
messages:
From: Alex Walters <alex.walters@devcon.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood - demo rotation / badging question for DevCon sponsorship

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for confirming Redwood as a Gold sponsor for DevCon (Sept 14-16). Two quick items from the ops team as we finalize floor plans:

1) Demo rotation windows — the floor manager is proposing a 20-minute demo cadence for demo pods between 10:00–16:00 both conference days. Can you confirm if Redwood can staff 20-min demos every hour (i.e., two demos per hour with a 20/40 split) or if you prefer a 30/30 split?

2) Badging & lead scan allotment — the Gold package includes 6 exhibitor badges and 2 demo-only badges. We have a request from the partner track to swap 1 exhibitor badge for a speaker badge if your speaker needs access to the green room. Is that something you'd want to do?

Attaching the latest sponsor packet and floorplan (DevCon_Sponsor_Pkg_v3.pdf, exhibit_floorplan_A.png). Happy to hop on a quick call tomorrow to walk through.

Best,
Alex
DevCon Events — Sponsorship Ops
From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Walters <alex.walters@devcon.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood - demo rotation / badging question for DevCon sponsorship

Alex —

Appreciate the packet and floorplan. Quick answers from our side:

- Demo cadence: We can staff a 20-min demo slot every hour (2x/hour) on Day 1, but Day 2 we'd need to reduce to 1x/hour (30-min) because of customer meetings and a keynote rehearsal. Marissa, fyi on the conflict with on-stage rehearsals.

- Badging: We're open to swapping 1 exhibitor badge for a speaker badge if your partner track confirms green room access and speaker parking. Otherwise we'd prefer to keep exhibitor coverage.

Can we firm these up in a short addendum to the sponsorship agreement? I've attached our benefits matrix (redwood_benefits_matrix.xlsx) with the items we'd like reflected (demo rotation cadence per day, badging swap conditional, two lead-scan devices). Dylan — can you confirm who on ops would manage the demo staffing schedule and the power/network needs for the pod?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, Alex Walters <alex.walters@devcon.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood - demo rotation / badging question for DevCon sponsorship

Alex / team —

Quick follow from Marketing: if Day 2 reduces demo frequency, we'd like the following trade-offs documented in the contract addendum:

- Replace the Day 2 extra demo slot with a 15-minute on-stage shoutout in the partner showcase (midday) plus one social media post from DevCon official channels tagging Redwood.
- Confirm logo rotation schedule on the main hall LED wall: Gold sponsors appear at minutes :00 and :30 in the loop; please confirm Redwood's logo file specs and placement order.

We can accept the badge swap so long as the speaker badge grants backstage/green room access and the speaker slot is within the keynote block (not the afternoon breakout). If DevCon needs a lead data-sharing agreement, we will need specifics on PII fields and retention (we prefer a 90-day TTL for lead exports).

Dylan — ops, can you confirm the pod power (1x 20A) and wired network drop (1) on the attached floorplan?

Marissa Cole
Head of Field & Brand
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Walters <alex.walters@devcon.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: samantha.price@devcon.com, dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood - demo rotation / badging question for DevCon sponsorship

Marissa / Kimberly —

Thanks for the clarity, this is helpful. Responses inline:

- We can document a Day 2 swap: one 15-minute partner showcase shoutout (midday) + one official social post. We'll note the shoutout slot as non-keynote but within the partner showcase stage; if you want a keynote slot we can discuss an additional fee.
- LED wall rotation: Gold logos appear at :00/:30 — please upload PNG/SVG at 1920x1080 and let us know if you prefer a left or right alignment.
- Badge swap: speaker badge will include green room access and speaker parking — confirmed.
- Lead data: we collect name, company, email, job title, and the session attended. We can support a 90-day TTL and will provide a CSV export via our partner portal.
- Pod power/network: confirmed 20A and one wired drop routed to the north side of the expo floor (see exhibit_floorplan_A.png). Dylan, I'll rely on you for final routing and cable labeling.

I'll issue a short addendum to the sponsorship agreement reflecting the above and send over a DocuSign link. Expect the addendum to include: Day 1 demo cadence (2x/hr), Day 2 demo cadence (1x/hr + partner shoutout), logo placement timing, badge swap language, and lead data terms.

Best,
Alex
Sponsorship Ops — DevCon Events
From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Walters <alex.walters@devcon.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood - demo rotation / badging question for DevCon sponsorship

Alex —

Thanks — that all looks workable. Confirming Redwood accepts the addendum as described (please include the logo spec and the 90-day TTL on leads). We'd like the DocuSign routed to me first, then to Marissa for brand sign-off.

Dylan — I'll coordinate staffing; expect a staffing roster from me by July 20. Also confirming we'll bring two lead-scanner devices and a USB fallback for CSV backups.

Please include the signed addendum and the finalized exhibit_floorplan with power drop marking in the HubSpot deal record once executed.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments referenced: DevCon_Sponsor_Pkg_v3.pdf, exhibit_floorplan_A.png, redwood_benefits_matrix.xlsx
